pro_course_detail.description:
Hi have 2 years experience preparing students for the Cambridge suite of exams.

These lessons focus primarily on the writing and speaking sections of the tests. However, I can help you with the reading and listening sections of the exams and provide you with tips and tricks on how to complete these sections effectively.

We will practice many of the speaking sections of the exams in class and I will help you improve your fluency and upgrade your vocabulary. I will note down any mistakes while you are speaking and we can review these together to help you improve your grammatical accuracy. I will provide all notes and corrections to you on google docs so you can review in your own time.

Homework will be provided after each lesson consisting of a writing task that you can complete in your own time and I will mark for you before our next lesson. We will then review it together and discuss how we can improve your grammar, vocabulary, punctuation, structure, cohesion and coherence.

I also take a genre approach to teaching writing. This means together we will look at a range of examples for letters, proposals, reports and essays to see the main things you need to include and what makes an excellent answer.

This course is aimed at teaching the 4 areas of the IELTS test - Speaking, Writing, Reading, Listening. We will learn the exam techniques necessary to help you achieve your maximum potential. 
Feel free to book a demo class to discuss your specific needs and which areas you'd like to focus on.

Speaking - In this course we will focus on everything needed to face the examiner on the day of the test with full confidence in our abilities. We will learn each section of the exam and understand what is required of us in all 3 sections. We will evaluate Pronunciation, phrasal verbs, and how to demonstrate competent conversation using appropriate grammatical structures and vocabulary.

Writing - The writing course focuses on exploring the test format and learning the best we need to develop in order to complete each task type. Together we will develop techniques on how to plan and write each section of the test, build confidence, and learn how to master our test performance so that we feel fully prepared for the test. Learning the language needed for successful answers is a key part of this course along with writing assessments.

Listening - The main issue many students have with the Listening test is how to judge which information is important and how to predict when this information will appear in the conversation. The listening course will focus on training your ear to know how to avoid distractions and centre on the key details needed to answer each question. We will also train our understanding of accents and paraphrasing.

Reading - The main focus of the reading course is to work our way through all the different task types that appear in the test, along with learning the necessary skills needed to complete each task. Learning these skills and when to use them, is vital in completing all 3 sections of the test in the required time. We will also work on all the preparation that can be done before the examination begins that will give you an advantage before you start.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
A relaxed and pressure-free environment to practice your conversational English with a qualified teacher who can correct your mistakes, improve your pronunciation, give you suggestions on authentic native expressions and improve your overall fluency. 

There are two possible options for conversational class:

1 - Topic-based conversation practice. We choose a topic for each session and go over it in class.  

2 - Free talk. We can talk about whatever you would like. A natural conversation that allows you to practice you expressing yourself while building your confidence in speaking English.

We can also practice choosing a topic and debating. This is an interesting and fun way to learn how to present and defend your opinion. I have a list of topics to choose from.

All notes are recorded for you to review after class.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
I have been teaching IELTS for three years. I have many satisfied students who have not only passed with flying colours but also made it to their country of choice. 

I am very familiar with the exam and what is required for the band score that you want. I can instantly pick up on weaknesses in your speaking answers and give you feedback on all aspects of your answer. I will provide you with techniques to improve and homework to practice working on the areas that need improving.  

Our speaking lessons are all personalized based on your strengths and weaknesses. But the general structure will be to go through current and common IELTS questions, I will give you feedback on your answers which will include:
-	Mistakes in pronunciation and grammar and how to fix these
-	Methods and strategies to improve your answer and general exam preparation
-	Alternative vocabulary
-	Native phrases and idioms

This class is for students who are already at an intermediate level of English.

If you are interested in studying IELTS writing, please message me.
